title: VersaRent
tagline: Mobile property management for landlords and tenants

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Landlords managing multiple units still rely on messaging threads, paper receipts and manual rent tracking. Tenants miss payment deadlines and landlords lose visibility into arrears until it is too late to act.

approach.title: How I approached it
approach.body: I designed VersaRent as a mobile-first platform I am building myself: landlords onboard properties from their phone, tenants receive push reminders and payments reconcile against unit ledgers. Supabase RLS keeps each landlord to their own portfolio.

technologies.title: Technologies
items: React Native + Expo for cross-platform iOS/Android
Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL and Edge Functions
Offline-first rent ledger with sync queue

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.body: Beta with 3 pilot landlords. Average rent collection time dropped from 12 days to 4 days after automated reminders. Full launch planned Q4 2026 with a tenant self-service portal.
